subject: Altimer SIG intake: scheduling, recording consent, and evidence owners
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@altimer.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake and next steps

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Altimer's security team would like to kick off a formal SIG/CAIQ intake and align on evidence we will need for our procurement review. Can we schedule a 45-minute intake call next week to walk through the CAIQ subset and confirm log/sample access?

High-level asks from our side:
- A CAIQ subset (we provided scope in the attached spreadsheet)
- Sample logs (redacted) for authentication and audit trails
- Recording consent for our internal review and for the external security panel

Proposed windows (PST): Wed 5/26 10:00-12:00 or Thu 5/27 09:00-11:00. If neither work, feel free to suggest alternate slots.

Attached: Altimer_CAIC_subset_v1.xlsx (scope)

Best,
Samantha Cole
Senior Security Program Manager
Altimer

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@altimer.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake and next steps

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for the attached scope. Wed 5/26 10:30 PST works for us. We can do a 45-minute intake to confirm the CAIQ subset and owners.

A few quick items for the call so we can come prepared:
- Can you confirm whether recording the call is OK for Altimer's security reviewers? We usually record intake calls for internal review and to capture action items.
- Which specific log windows do you need access to (e.g., auth events for last 30 days, admin audit logs for 90 days)? If you can spell that out in the call, we'll have the right samples ready.

I'll route this to our evidence owners internally (Laura + Marissa) so they can bring the relevant artifacts. Attaching a short pre-read with the CAIQ subset and our suggested owners.

Attachments: log_sample_instructions.pdf (instructions + placeholder for secure file transfer)

Proposed calendar: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:30-11:15 PST — joining details to follow once you confirm recording consent.

Looking forward —
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Altimer intake prep and artifact owners (do not forward)

Laura / Marissa — quick prep notes before the 10:30 intake (call in ~2h):

Context: Altimer wants a SIG/CAIQ intake + sample logs for procurement. They attached a CAIQ subset (linked in the external thread). Expect standard SOC2-related questions + some cloud residency clarifications.

Owners we should present:
- Laura: CAIQ control responses + CAIQ subset mapping (I put you as primary)
- Marissa: Logging samples and retention notes (you own the demo for auth/admin logs)

Artifacts to have ready or know where to get immediately:
- CAIQ subset draft (I prepared the initial mapping — will share in call)
- Redacted auth event logs for last 30 days (S3 secure transfer)
- Admin audit snapshots (last 90 days)
- Short onboarding doc for log sample delivery process (see attached instructions)

Risk notes: Altimer asked about recording the call for review. If they approve, we'll record but avoid repeating any customer PII during the session.

Action items before 10:30:
- Laura: quick scan of CAIQ subset, mark any open items (15 min)
- Marissa: confirm we can produce a redacted auth log sample within 48 hours and that secure transfer path is available (20 min)

Thanks — I will confirm recording consent and finalize calendar invite.

-Rishi

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@altimer.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake and next steps

Hi Samantha — confirmed for Wed 26 May 2027 10:30 PST; thank you for the call. Recap and follow-ups below (copying our owners so action items are visible):

Recap (short):
- We reviewed Altimer's CAIQ subset scope and mapped primary owners. Laura will own CAIQ response edits; Marissa will own log sample delivery.
- Altimer provided recording consent: Samantha confirmed the security team is ok with the intake call being recorded for internal review.
- We clarified the requested log windows: auth events (30 days) and admin audit events (90 days).

Action items and owners:
- Marissa Cole (Redwood): Deliver redacted auth event sample (30 days) and admin audit snapshot (90 days) via secure transfer by 2027-05-29 EOD. Attachments: log_sample_instructions.pdf used as transfer checklist.
- Laura Bennett (Redwood): Finalize CAIQ subset responses and return updated spreadsheet by 2027-06-02 COB (see Altimer_CAIC_subset_v1.xlsx).
- Samantha / Altimer: Confirm any additional scope exclusions and whether the external security panel needs separate sign-off for the recording (by 2027-05-28).

Attachments provided in this thread for reference: Altimer_CAIC_subset_v1.xlsx, log_sample_instructions.pdf.

Next meeting: TBD — we'll propose a follow-up after artifacts are delivered and reviewed.

Thanks again — please reply to confirm you saw the action items.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
